summary: Specific performance dispute; readiness/willingness requirement unproven; plaintiff's delay in payment despite property measurement confirmation; attachment issue resolution obligation ignored; balance consideration non-remittance led to agreement forfeiture; market value escalation after 14 years; evidence insufficient for specific performance claim; Trial Court partial decree affirmed, High Court error in decreeing full specific performance.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Trial Court decree restoring advance money recovery upheld.
